_comment: Mission sequence. Orders come from somewhere, but where is never settled. Every mission carries a mundane and an uncanny account of its origin (DESIGN.md section 7); the player sees neither, only the provenance.

missions.title: Sink the battleship
missions.briefing: Intercept and destroy a capital ship expected on the northern lane. Heavy escort likely.

provenance.channel: Sealed envelope, handed over on the pier before sailing.

missions.mundane_origin: A routine operations plan drawn up by the staff from agent reports.
missions.uncanny_origin: The countersignature belongs to an officer who left the staff roll two years ago.

missions.title: Find the convoy and report
missions.briefing: Patrol the grid and locate the enemy convoy. Report position and composition. Do not engage.

provenance.channel: Radio relay, received on the third watch.
provenance.signed: No signature. Call sign recognised, frequency is not.

missions.mundane_origin: A relay station on a backup frequency after the usual one was jammed.
missions.uncanny_origin: The call sign belongs to a station that was shelled out of existence in spring.

missions.title: Sink the steamer Santa Lucia
missions.briefing: A supply steamer is carrying munitions to the front under false hospital markings. Sink her. Ignore the markings; they are a ruse.

provenance.channel: Found in the captain's cabin safe. Nobody remembers it arriving.
provenance.signed: Illegible. The handwriting looks like your own.

missions.mundane_origin: An order slipped to the captain by a rival staff faction, or enemy deception designed to make a boat commit a war crime.
missions.uncanny_origin: It was written in the captain's own hand by something that wanted the ship sunk.

missions.title: Return by the northern lane
missions.briefing: Return to base by the northern lane. Make no stops and no contact. Radio silence is absolute.

provenance.channel: No channel recorded. It is in the log under today's date.

missions.mundane_origin: Standing return instructions the mate copied into the log and forgot.
missions.uncanny_origin: Nobody wrote it. It was already in the log.
